New in p7: Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.CascadingParameterSubscription, and CascadingValueServiceCollectionExtensions.TryAddCascadingValueSupplier<TAttribute>(IServiceCollection, Func<IServiceProvider, Func<ComponentState, TAttribute, CascadingParameterInfo, CascadingParameterSubscription>>). CascadingParameterAttributeBase already existed publicly in .NET 10.

New in p7: Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.CacheView (CacheKey, Enabled, ExpiresAfter, ExpiresOn, ExpiresSliding, VaryBy, VaryByQuery, VaryByRoute, VaryByHeader, VaryByCookie, VaryByUser (bool), VaryByCulture (bool)), CacheBehaviorAttribute(CacheBehavior {Rerender, Throw}), CacheConditionAttribute(CacheVaryBy) and enum CacheVaryBy {None, Query, Route, Header, Cookie, User, Culture}. RazorComponentsServiceOptions.CacheViewSizeLimit is a long. Components.Endpoints references HybridCache. AddHybridCache is not in the shared framework: it comes from the Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.Hybrid NuGet package.

The .NET 10 Components.Endpoints.dll contains the error "Templated content can't be passed across a rendermode boundary". p7 removes it and adds RenderFragmentSerializer to Endpoints and Server. RenderTreeBuilder.SetAttributeValue(int, object) is new in p7 but is only tagged [Experimental("ASP0032")] in RC1.

The config key string "Components:UseCultureFromServer" is in Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.WebAssembly.Server.dll in p7 and RC1, and not in 10. The listed InteractiveWebAssemblyBrowserOptions.ApplicationCulture exists only in RC1. In p7 the same property is WebAssemblyBrowserOptions.ApplicationCulture.

New in the QuickGrid p7 package: QuickGrid<TGridItem>.QueryParameterNameOptions, and QueryParameterNameOptions(string) with Sort, Direction and Page. The AppContext switch string "Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.QuickGrid.EnableUrlBasedQuickGridNavigationAndSorting" is in QuickGrid.dll in p7 and RC1. Paginator and PaginationState already existed.
QuickGrid<TGridItem>.OnRowClick : EventCallback<TGridItem> is new in p7. The row-clickable CSS class is in the p7 QuickGrid scoped CSS bundle but not in 10.0.2. RowClass already existed.

New in p7: QuickGrid<TGridItem>.InitialItemIndex (int), ScrollToItemAsync(int, CancellationToken), AnchorMode (VirtualizeAnchorMode) and ItemComparer (IEqualityComparer<TGridItem>). AnchorMode and ItemComparer are [Experimental("ASP0030")] in both p7 and RC1.
This is behavioural. ItemSize and OverscanCount already existed. The p7 JS (web, server and webassembly) adds ResizeObserver and overflow-anchor handling that is not in 10.0.2.

New in p7: Virtualize<TItem>.AnchorMode, enum Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Web.Virtualization.VirtualizeAnchorMode {Start, End, None}, and Virtualize<TItem>.ItemComparer. These are not experimental on Virtualize. BL0011 is in the p7 Components.Analyzers.dll but not in 10.
Virtualize<TItem>.InitialItemIndex (int) and ScrollToItemAsync(int, CancellationToken) : Task are new in p7.
The data-blazor-virtualize-reserved-height attribute (along with data-blazor-virtualize-loop-breaker-transform) is in the p7 and RC1 blazor.web, server and webassembly JS but not in 10.0.2.

None of these exist in p7 or RC1, in .NET API or strings: AutoPause, AddAutoPause, AutoPauseBrowserOptions, HiddenDelay, or Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Server.AutoPause. The JS has no hidden-tab auto-pause either: visibilitychange is only used for the reconnect retry, as in .NET 10. onCircuitPausing exists, but as a circuit handler hook for pauses.

Circuit.RequestCircuitPauseAsync(CancellationToken) : Task<bool> is new in p7. There is no onPauseRequested in JS. The server sends "JS.RequestPause", and the client then runs handleServerInitiatedPause, which calls the onCircuitPausing(abortSignal) callbacks registered through Blazor.start({circuitHandlers:[...]}) (p7). CircuitHandler, [PersistentState] and IHostApplicationLifetime already existed.

In p7: RazorComponentsEndpointConventionBuilder.WithBrowserOptions(Action<BrowserOptions>), BrowserOptions, InteractiveServerBrowserOptions and ConfigureBrowser, but the other names differ. RC1 has StaticServerBrowserOptions, InteractiveWebAssemblyBrowserOptions, BrowserOptions.StaticServer / InteractiveServer / InteractiveWebAssembly, and static BrowserOptions.GetBrowserOptions(HttpContext). p7 has SsrBrowserOptions, WebAssemblyBrowserOptions, BrowserOptions.Ssr / Server / WebAssembly, and an extension httpContext.GetBrowserOptions() (BrowserOptionsHttpContextExtensions). ConfigureBrowser.HttpContext was removed in RC1.

ServerComponentsEndpointOptions.ConfigureConnection : Action<HttpConnectionDispatcherOptions> is new in p7. HttpConnectionDispatcherOptions and CloseOnAuthenticationExpiration already existed in .NET 10.

The SignalR primitives are in p7: HttpConnectionDispatcherOptions.EnableAuthenticationRefresh and HubConnection.RefreshAuthenticationAsync(CancellationToken). But only the RC1 Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Server.dll uses them (IConnectionAuthenticationRefreshFeature, set_EnableAuthenticationRefresh, OnAuthenticationRefreshedAsync); the p7 Components.Server.dll has no auth-refresh code. RC1 also changes OnAuthenticationRefresh to Func<AuthenticationRefreshContext,Task<bool>>, and adds MaximumAuthenticationExpiration and the HubConnection AuthenticationRefreshed / AuthenticationRefreshFailed events.

New in p7: Microsoft.AspNetCore.Antiforgery.ICsrfProtection.ValidateAsync(HttpContext) : ValueTask<CsrfProtectionResult>, with CsrfProtectionResult.Allowed() / Denied(). The "DisableCsrfProtection" config string is in Microsoft.AspNetCore.dll (p7 and RC1, not 10). Components.Endpoints references CsrfProtection. The 11 Blazor template drops UseAntiforgery, which the 10 template had. IAntiforgeryValidationFeature and RequireAntiforgeryTokenAttribute already existed.

IAuthorizationRequirementData already existed. New in p7: the overload AuthorizationPolicy.CombineAsync(IAuthorizationPolicyProvider, IEnumerable<object>), which accepts authorize data and requirement data. AuthorizeView and AuthorizeRouteView are unchanged at the API level, so the AuthorizeView/AuthorizeRouteView side itself is behavioural.

The p7 and RC1 BlazorWeb template has Components/Account/PasskeyAuthenticators.cs (an AAGUID-to-name map with GetDisplayName and TryGetDefaultDisplayName); the .NET 10 template does not. UserPasskeyInfo.Aaguid and IdentityPasskeyData.Aaguid are new in p7. SignInManager<TUser>.PasskeySignInAsync(string) and PreSignInCheck already existed.

Both the p7 and RC1 BlazorWeb templates still register IdentityRevalidatingAuthenticationStateProvider, a RevalidatingServerAuthenticationStateProvider with a 30-minute RevalidationInterval. Neither template contains CloseOnAuthenticationExpiration, EnableAuthenticationRefresh or ConfigureConnection, so the switch has not shipped in either.
Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Web.EnvironmentView with Include (string), Exclude (string) and ChildContent is new in p7. EnvironmentBoundary does not exist in p7 or RC1.

The component is Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Endpoints.BasePath (note the Endpoints namespace), new in p7. The p7 template App.razor uses <BasePath />. NavigationManager.BaseUri and UsePathBase already existed.
NavigationOptions.RelativeToCurrentUri (bool) and NavLink.RelativeToCurrentUri (bool) are new in p7. The NavigationManager.NavigateTo overloads are unchanged.
NavigationManagerExtensions.GetUriWithFragment(NavigationManager, string) is new in p7. GetUriWithHash is not present in .NET 10, p7 or RC1.
These are behavioural. MapRazorComponents, ResourcePreloader, data-permanent and Router.OnNavigateAsync all exist unchanged since .NET 10.

The NuGet packages Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Gateway (from preview.5) and Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Gateway.Cli (from p7) exist; both are 11.0.0-preview.7.26381.103 and RC1. They are tools-only packages (blazor-gateway.dll bundling Yarp.ReverseProxy) and the build targets set RunCommand. StaticWebAssetSpaFallbackEnabled is in the p7 SDK StaticWebAssets targets but not in 10. The p7 blazorwasm template references the Gateway instead of DevServer and sets StaticWebAssetSpaFallbackEnabled=true. UseWebAssemblyDebugging is [Obsolete, DiagnosticId=ASPDEPR011] in p7, and was not obsolete in 10.

This is behavioural, and I verified it in the implementation: the p7 and RC1 Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.WebAssembly.dll references IHostedService and StartAsync, and the 10.0.2 one does not. IHostedService, BackgroundService, AddHostedService and WebAssemblyHost.RunAsync already existed.

The p7 WebAssembly.dll calls AddEnvironmentVariables; 10 does not. The listed InteractiveWebAssemblyBrowserOptions.EnvironmentVariables (IDictionary<string,string>) is the RC1 name. In p7 it is WebAssemblyBrowserOptions.EnvironmentVariables. WebAssemblyHostBuilder.CreateDefault and IConfiguration are unchanged.

The template short name is blazorwasm-servicedefaults, not blazor-wasm-servicedefaults (it is in p7 and RC1 and was not in 10). AddBlazorClientServiceDefaults(this WebAssemblyHostBuilder) is code generated by the template, not a framework API. It adds the meters "Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components" and ".Lifecycle" and the source "Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components". ComponentsMetrics and ComponentsActivitySource are internal types. The public API is AddComponentsMetrics/AddComponentsTracing, which existed in 10, and is wired into WebAssembly.dll from p7. Meter.IsSupported is the AppContext switch "System.Diagnostics.Metrics.Meter.IsSupported", not a public property; the Components and WebAssembly DLLs reference it from p7.

This is an out-of-band Aspire package, Aspire.Hosting.Blazor; the first version is 13.5.4-preview.1.26464.4, after RC1, and the latest is 13.6.1-preview.1.26506.6. In BlazorGatewayExtensions: AddBlazorWasmProject<TProject>(builder, name), AddBlazorWasmApp, AddBlazorGateway(builder, name), and WithBlazorClientApp(gateway, wasmApp, ...) on Project and DotnetProject resources. It is marked [Experimental("ASPIREBLAZOR001")].

The blazorwebworker template (Microsoft.Web.Blazor.WebWorker.Library.CSharp.11.0) is in the p7 and RC1 templates and not in 10. WebWorkerClient is template code: static CreateAsync(IJSRuntime, int timeoutMs, string? assemblyName, CancellationToken), InvokeAsync<TResult>(string method, object[] args, ...), InvokeVoidAsync(...) and DisposeAsync. WorkerMethods uses [JSExport], which already existed.

The perf changes are behavioural. The listed APIs all predate 11: FeatureSwitchDefinitionAttribute (.NET 9+), MetadataUpdater.IsSupported, and dotnet.download() (in the 10.0.2 Mono dotnet.js). Meter.IsSupported is an AppContext switch; the Components and WebAssembly DLLs reference it from p7.

The p7 Microsoft.NET.Sdk.WebAssembly.Pack targets say "UseMonoRuntime=false indicates CoreCLR; when true or unset, Mono workload" and have RuntimeFlavor=='CoreCLR' handling. The CoreCLR runtime pack microsoft.netcore.app.runtime.browser-wasm (p7) dotnet.js has Webcil support and GetDotNetRuntimeHeap; the Mono pack does not. The p7 and RC1 emscripten workload manifests use Emscripten 6.0.2 (10.0.2 used 3.1.56). wasm-tools is a workload id, not an API.
BL0010 through BL0016 are all in the p7 and RC1 Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Analyzers.dll, in both the App.Ref analyzers folder and the NuGet package. The 10.0.2 version only goes up to BL0009.

Already in the p7 BlazorWeb template: <BasePath /> in App.razor, NavMenu.razor.js referenced from NavMenu.razor, [PersistentState(AllowUpdates = true)] in Weather.razor, and supportsDocker in ide.host.json (new for BlazorWeb in 11, absent in 10). The RazorComponent item template's use-code-behind option (with Component1.razor.cs) exists only in RC1.

Removed in p7 relative to 10: Router.PreferExactMatches; EnableDataAnnotationsValidation(EditContext) (the overload without IServiceProvider) and AddDataAnnotationsValidation; SignOutSessionStateManager; RemoteBrowserFileStreamOptions; WebEventCallbackFactoryEventArgsExtensions; and WebRenderer.RendererId. AccessTokenResult.InteractiveRequestUrl was not removed and is still present and non-obsolete in p7 and RC1. What was removed is AccessTokenResult.RedirectUrl and the 3-argument AccessTokenResult constructor.

I compiled 'public union Pet(Cat, Dog);' on p7, which needs <LangVersion>preview</LangVersion>, and on RC1 with the default LangVersion. JsonUnionAttribute (TypeClassifier) is in p7, but deserialisation throws 'ambiguous for union type' without a classifier. JsonUnionTypeStructuralClassifier exists only in RC1; [JsonUnion(TypeClassifier = typeof(JsonUnionTypeStructuralClassifier))] round-trips correctly on RC1. [Parameter] and [PersistentState] are unchanged.

union, closed class and [with(capacity: 10), 1, 2, 3] all compile and run on p7 with LangVersion=preview, and on RC1 with the default. The compiled DLL carries IsClosedTypeAttribute, UnionAttribute and IUnion. JsonSerializerOptions.InferClosedTypePolymorphism and JsonSourceGenerationOptionsAttribute.InferClosedTypePolymorphism are in p7; JsonPolymorphicAttribute.InferClosedTypePolymorphism is RC1-only.
Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.IComponentPropertyActivator with GetActivator(Type) : Action<IServiceProvider, IComponent> is new in p7. InjectAttribute.Key already existed (.NET 9+).
Blazor.start, IJSObjectReference.DisposeAsync, JSDisconnectedException, ElementReference and Blazor.registerCustomEventType all exist unchanged in 10.0.2, p7 and RC1, so the polish is behavioural.

The p7 and RC1 JS (web, server and webassembly) adds the MathML namespace 'http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML' and document.createElementNS(MathML,'mrow'): 4 createElementNS calls versus 2 in 10.0.2, which has no MathML.

BlazorWebView.StaticContentCacheControlProvider (Func<BlazorWebViewStaticContentRequest,string>) and IBlazorWebView.StaticContentCacheControlProvider exist only in Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.WebView.Maui 11.0.0-rc.1.26451.6, not in 11.0.0-preview.7.26406.9 or 10.0.110. - **JS:** greps of blazor.web/server/webassembly.js and dotnet.js.
- **Templates:** greps of the template content.
- **Compiler behaviour:** test compiles on p7 and RC1.

**Things that matter for the showcase**

1. **p7 → RC1 renames.** Code written against p7 will break on RC1:
   - SsrBrowserOptions → StaticServerBrowserOptions
   - WebAssemblyBrowserOptions → InteractiveWebAssemblyBrowserOptions
   - BrowserOptions.Ssr / Server / WebAssembly → .StaticServer / .InteractiveServer / .InteractiveWebAssembly
   - the httpContext.GetBrowserOptions() extension → static BrowserOptions.GetBrowserOptions(HttpContext)
   - ConfigureBrowser.HttpContext is removed
   - ValidationOptions.MessageKeyProvider and ValidationMessageKeyContext are removed
   - Testing: ServerFixture<T> → ServerFactory<T>

2. **RC1-only additions:**
   - AssetPath attributes (but no compiler support yet)
   - CircuitOptions.JsonTypeInfoResolvers (ASPNETCORE9004)
   - the ASP0032 tag on RenderTreeBuilder.SetAttributeValue
   - JsonUnionTypeStructuralClassifier and JsonPolymorphicAttribute.InferClosedTypePolymorphism
   - Blazor circuit auth-refresh wiring in Components.Server
   - HttpConnectionDispatcherOptions.MaximumAuthenticationExpiration
   - the HubConnection AuthenticationRefreshed / AuthenticationRefreshFailed events
   - the use-code-behind item template option
   - MAUI StaticContentCacheControlProvider
   - DeviceBoundSessions

3. **Out-of-band packages versioned "11.0.0-preview.7.26425.128":** Components.AI, Testing and Media come from the RC1 build, not p7. The richer AI surface is only in the later 0.1.0-preview.1.26466.103 (UIAgent<TState>, FunctionApprovalBlock, ToolBlock, RegisterUIAction).

4. **C# 15 on p7:** union, closed and with() need <LangVersion>preview</LangVersion>; RC1 enables them by default.

5. **Not found in p7 or RC1:** circuit auto-pause, the Identity template's switch to auth refresh, and compile-time ~/ expansion.
